name: BN4_ENEMY_STATS
description: a record per enemy id, BN4_ENEMY_STAT_SIZE bytes (0 MegaMan, 1-126 the viruses, 128 on the Navis)
how: Found by the HP read in romlab: battles forced with enemy 1, 3, 5 and 13 alone held 40, 100, 180 and 50 in one RAM word of the enemy's (`0x0203B27C` that time); the one table of the ROM with those at a fixed stride is this one. +0 element << 12 \| HP (BN6's first word's form: VolGear's `0x1050`, Fire, 80), +3 the kind (4 a virus, 8 a Navi), +4 the family or the Navi's number, +5 the version (0-5), +10 a u16 attack (Mettaur 10, Mettaur3 160). 120 viruses and 95 Navi records.

name: BN4_BATTLE_TABLES
description: two pointers, the real world's map groups and the net's (group - 0x80, 21): per group a pointer per map index (16 a story stage), per index a list of BN4_RECORD_SIZE records, 0xFF ending them
how: Verified in romlab: ACDC Area's first record (`0x080FD65C`) fields two Mettaurs at its panels (5, 2) and (6, 3); a record written with enemy 7 at (4, 1) and 13 at (5, 2) fields VolGear (80 HP) and Billy (50) there; enemy 1 written with kind 5 is a rock.

name: BN4_ENCOUNTER_RATES
description: 16 bytes per net group (group - 0x80), one per map: its rate's class, 7 none
verified: docs/rom/bn4.md:43 (The encounter check and the roll)
how: Verified in romlab: the check patched to `ldr r0,=record; bx lr` starts that battle from Lan's room (`tools/bn4_lab.py battle`).
